name: todaypolicy-50hz-v1

default.known_limit: 1/12 rise over_current (mixed-start DR-0); 2/12 tilt_roll falls (own-DR 0.2 hold/sto + lower/sto)

walk_turn_capable.note: not the bundle default walk role -- loads into the same rl_walk_weights.json slot as walk_straight; pick this one only when joystick turning is required.
walk_turn_capable.known_limit_massfix_2026_09_11: corrected-mass (3.490kg) re-check IMPROVES the pre-fix numbers above: hold/det terms 2->0, hold/sto terms 3->2 (pooled panel terms 5->2); walk/det gait_valid unchanged 6/6. Evidence: logs/ckpt_eval/cw_turn50hz_standwalk_cap29_stdwalklohi_warmadapt_canary2m_acq1_gate_massfix/report.json.

turn_composition_2026_09_12.status: CONFIRMED to prevent a real freeze on this exact bundle checkpoint when a session holds sustained turn-in-place long enough to reach its known continuous-single-mode degeneration point (see matched_raw_vs_composed_pair_2026_09_12 below for the controlled evidence and its honest caveat) -- REQUIRED for any sustained joystick turn-in-place command; leaving it off costs nothing on straight-walk/mixed-natural-mix ticks (bit-exact at blend_s=0.0 default, and empirically near-identical on the core gate panel -- see gate_delta below).
turn_composition_2026_09_12.why: this checkpoint's own real wz-authority training does track short/moderate turn commands (probe_turn_authority wz_med +-0.19 rad/s), but amp track's independent turncurr lineage found sustained turn-in-place freezes 6/6 mechanisms; rather than assume this is/isn't the same gap, todaypolicy/amp built a non-RL composition (any_means: explicit controller composition) as a safety net: on ticks the env itself classifies as live turn-in-place (s_ref<=1e-3 and |wz_ref|>1e-3 -- the same flag walk_task.py already computes), the action is swapped to hexapod_core.tripod_gait.TripodGait (the same scripted teacher this codebase's own BC-anchor/reward machinery already treats as ground truth turn behavior elsewhere), blended over blend_s seconds; straight-walk ticks are untouched, the real policy drives them exactly as trained.
turn_composition_2026_09_12.mechanism: rl_move/sim/probe_turn_compose.py:_ComposedPolicy, wired into rl_move/sim/eval_checkpoint.py and rl_move/sim/drive_video.py via --compose-turn-blend-s (float seconds, default None = no wrap/bit-exact old behavior)
turn_composition_2026_09_12.cli_addition: --compose-turn-blend-s 0.15 (append to any eval_checkpoint.py/drive_video.py invocation against turn50hz_standwalk_cap29_stdwalklohi_warmadapt_canary2m_acq1.zip or its s1 twin)
turn_composition_2026_09_12.gate_delta: full walk/rise/lower/hold det+sto panel (+ auto walk_startjitter) at blend_s=0.15 vs the SAME corrected-mass uncomposed gate (gate_massfix, apples-to-apples -- amp's own STATUS entry this same day diffed against the pre-massfix '_gate' instead, an avoidable mass confound; this composition.json entry uses the correct massfix comparator): walk/det, rise/det, lower/det, hold/det, walk/sto, rise/sto, lower/sto, hold/sto are ALL numerically identical panel-level (gait_valid/terms unchanged on every one); only walk_startjitter (the one sub-panel whose natural goal draw occasionally includes a turn-in-place tick) shows small per-episode deltas (e.g. det ep0 fwd 0.06->0.01m, ep4 ok False->True), consistent with the composition engaging on a handful of ticks and otherwise being a true no-op elsewhere in this panel. Net: composing costs nothing on the core modes.
turn_composition_2026_09_12.positive_evidence: logs/manual_drive/cap29_acq1_composed_humanturn/summary.json (20s human_turn script, blend_s=0.15): terminated=false, gait_valid=true, sacrificed_legs=[], turn_wz_err_med_rad_s=0.0747 (real tracking, course_err_2s_med_deg=10.14 on motion-valid windows), cur_max_a=2.573A (inside the 50Hz motor contract). Frame strip (logs/manual_drive/cap29_acq1_composed_humanturn/drive_sheet.png) shows genuine per-frame leg reconfiguration through curved turn-in-place arcs, not the static splayed freeze-crouch amp's own turncurr lineage showed at every RL-side lever.
turn_composition_2026_09_12.matched_raw_vs_composed_pair_2026_09_12: CLOSED the gap flagged above, WITH the confound this track's own 06:0x entry already found controlled for (not re-litigated as new). Ran rl_move/sim/probe_turn_compose.py directly on THIS checkpoint (ppo_goal_cw_turn50hz_standwalk_cap29_stdwalklohi_warmadapt_canary2m_acq1.zip), full training cfg-set replayed verbatim, dr_scale=0, 15s@50Hz (matched to the official gate's own episode length per the 06:0x root-cause). Two batches: (A) goal.walk_turn_in_place_frac=1.0, 4 seeds: RAW gait_valid=False 4/4 (sacrificed_legs [1,4] on 3, [1,4,5] on 1, forward_dist_m 0.010-0.017, mean|wz|_turn 0.026-0.035 rad/s noise-floor); COMPOSED gait_valid=True 4/4, sacrificed_legs=[] every seed, mean|wz|_turn 0.145-0.159 rad/s (5-6x raw, in probe_turn_authority's own passing band). (B) control, goal.walk_turn_in_place_frac=0.0, 3 seeds (turn_ticks=0 confirmed every seed): RAW and COMPOSED are BYTE-IDENTICAL (mp4 files match exactly) and BOTH freeze the same way (sacrificed_legs [1] or [1,5], forward_dist_m 0.011-0.028) -- this replicates, not discovers, the track's own already-documented continuous-single-mode-duration artifact (STATUS.md 06:0x `..._tip_matched15s` entry: pure forced walk past ~7-8s degrades on this checkpoint regardless of turn content). READ TOGETHER: batch (B) proves RAW's freeze in batch (A) is NOT itself evidence of a turn-specific defect (continuous single-mode duration alone is sufficient to cause it) -- but batch (B) also proves the composed wrapper provides ZERO protection when there are no turn ticks to substitute (composed=raw exactly), so batch (A)'s fix is causally tied to the actual turn-tick action substitutions, not an artifact of wrapping/resetting the model. Net, honest verdict: the composition is CONFIRMED to prevent this checkpoint's continuous-duration freeze specifically on sessions that include sustained turn-in-place segments long enough to reach the degeneration point -- a real, practically load-bearing safety property for real joystick sessions with sustained turning -- but whether the deeper mechanism is turn-action-specific (H2) versus any-sustained-action-substitution-would-also-work (H1) is NOT isolated by this evidence (would need a further control substituting non-turn actions on the same tick pattern) and does not change the practical recommendation either way. Evidence: logs/probe_turn_compose/cap29_acq1_tip1/{report.json,raw_*.png,composed_*.png} (batch A); logs/probe_turn_compose/cap29_acq1_purewalk_control/report.json (batch B control, byte-identical raw/composed mp4s).
